origin: Original procedural voice-like synthesis made for Makers & Challengers.
method: Glottal harmonics shaped by moving vowel formants, detuned second throat, low vocal growl and a short diffuse tail. No impact, explosion or metallic layer.
license_note: Self-created from mathematical oscillators and seeded noise. No external sample license, commercial-use restriction from third-party recordings, or third-party attribution requirement. Generator is included.
